relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: resulting in the activation of the receptor with a consequent increase in cAMP

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: The increase in CGRP together with the increase in cAMP leads to one of the effects responsible for migraine pain, vasodilation.

relationships.subject: nitric oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: NO is able to upregulate CGRP in trigeminal ganglion neurons [28].

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecules such as olcegepant and telcagepant prevent binding of the initial CGRP, blocking the entire receptor activation process [49,50,51].

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: In this case, the antibody binds CGRP, blocking its release centrally, thus relieving pain in migraine sufferers.

key_findings: Review: CGRP signaling via cAMP drives vasodilation in migraine; gepants and anti-CGRP mAbs block it; ketogenic diet reduces attacks.
